scenarios.name: Stop wheel navigation at the visible ends of the part ribbon

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full ribbon visible
the 3D Model tab is the first visible command tab and is active
the user scrolls up over the 3D Model tab
the user selects the last visible command tab
the user scrolls down over the last visible command tab
the last visible command tab remains active
